messages:
Ravi (PM): Shared a trimmed prototype for first-run onboarding: modal checklist vs persistent strip + sample cards. quick feedback? https://www.figma.com/file/shortlink
Nora (Design): Modal feels clear for brand-new accounts. Strip is lighter but easy to miss. Suggest grid (2x3) in modal on desktop, stacked cards on mobile.
Chen (Product): Add a small header pill showing progress (e.g. Onboarding: 2/5) that links to resume. We'll expose sample.metadata.cost_tier so UI can show 'Low cost' tag.
Ivy (Frontend): Implementation notes: modal must trap focus; strip use <section role="region" aria-label="Onboarding quick actions">. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Provide focus-visible on tiles.
Priya (A11y): Contrast: thin outline CTAs fail 4.5:1. Use filled CTAs or darker borders. Carousel mode needs arrow-key support and `aria-roledescription="carousel"`. Announce progress with `aria-live="polite"`.
Nora (Design): Microcopy: header "Set up Redwood in minutes". Steps: Create / Connect / Verify / Ship. Primary CTA: "Start checklist". Secondary: "Try a demo". Use tags: Demo / Low cost / Prod-ready (with icon).
Ravi (PM): Plan: A/B test modal-first vs strip-first. Metrics: checklist completion, sample-launch rate. Schedule 3 quick playtests next Wed.
staging-bot: Preview URL: https://staging.redwood.internal/onboard/preview?exp=onboard_modal_v1 :white_check_mark:
Ivy (Frontend): I'll add keyboard e2e tests (arrow keys, home/end, focus trap) and an undo toast when strip is dismissed.
Priya (A11y): PR checklist: contrast, focus order, focus-visible outlines, live region messages, screen reader walkthrough. I'll review the PR before merge.
Ravi (PM): Great — Nora will update figma, Chen will wire telemetry events, Ivy will implement. Follow up after playtests.
